about: Requests to build something, with checks the result must pass. The runner arrives with the verify step (todo.md, Phase 1): it sends each prompt to the real model, renders what was built in headless Chrome and applies `checks`. Run it with the 4B model; judge every change to the build tools by the pass rate.

checks_key.renders: the panel or app opens without a console error or a blank body
checks_key.text: every string appears somewhere a person can read it: the panel text, placeholders and labels
checks_key.selectors: every CSS selector matches at least one element
checks_key.interact: optional steps [{click|type: selector, value?}] followed by {expect_text}
checks_key.seed: a POST made before the prompt, so there is data to show
checks_key.edit: kind edit: `setup` names a prompt to build first; the model must then change that panel in place (same panel, version 2 or more)

prompts.prompt: Make a pomodoro timer app with a 25 minute countdown and start, pause and reset buttons.
Build a unit converter panel that converts kilometres to miles as I type.
Create a tip calculator: bill amount, tip percentage, and the total.
Make a counter app with plus and minus buttons and a reset.
Build a stopwatch with start, stop and lap buttons.
A panel with a text box on top and a live preview of the Markdown below it.
Create an app to track my habits: name, days per week, notes, and whether it is done today.
Create a weather app for a city using Open-Meteo.
Create an app that schedules Google Meet meetings, lets me add guests and change the time, and cancels them.
Change the counter so the plus button adds 5 instead of 1.
Make the pomodoro timer 10 minutes instead of 25.
Make a panel that lists my open to-dos.
Add a button to the top bar that opens my notes.
